title: Warrior armor
wikitext: {{TOCright}} A full set of [[Warrior]] armor consists of a helm, hauberk or cuirass, gauntlets, leggings and boots. ==Armor bonuses== [[Basic armor|Basic]] warrior armor provides up to a maximum of 80 [[armor rating|armor]] and 20 extra armor against [[physical damage]].
